title: Blow-up change of variables for weighted Hausdorff integrals
statement:
Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ. Let M ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} be an arbitrary set; no measurability is assumed. Let f, θ : ℝ^{n+ℓ} → ℝ be arbitrary functions, x ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ} and r > 0. Write η_{x,r}(y) := r⁻¹(y − x) (Chapter03.blowUpMap x r) and Hⁿ := μHE[n]. With Bochner integrals, which equal 0 for non-integrable integrands,
∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f(y)·θ(x + r y) dHⁿ(y) = r⁻ⁿ ∫_M f(η_{x,r}(z))·θ(z) dHⁿ(z).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (M : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (f θ : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (x : Amb n ℓ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M, f y * θ (x + r • y) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) = (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z in M, f (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r z) * θ z ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))
